test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Two trains, 148 m and 152 m long, are running towards each other on parallel lines at 62 km/h and 46km/h, respectively. In what time will they be clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 148 m

Length of Train 2 = 152 m

Speed of Train 1 = 62 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 46 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

Total Distance = Length of Train 1 + Length of Train 2

Relative Speed (when trains are moving towards each other) = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2

**Calculation:**

Total Distance = 148 + 152 = 300 m

Relative Speed = 62 + 46 = 108 km/h

Convert Relative Speed to m/s:

⇒ 108 × (1000/3600) = 30 m/s

Time = Total Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 300 / 30

⇒ Time = 10 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
